result.title: Action-Conditioned Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
result.summary: We study spatio-temporal forecasting in networked systems under specified actions. The challenge is to capture the action's effects without predicting spurious changes in unaffected regions. However, direct supervision and evaluation of these effects require paired futures with and without the action, whereas observational trajectories reveal only the realized future. We introduce PairST, a benchmark comprising six datasets across traffic, power transmission and water distribution, with paired reference and intervened futures simulated from the same system state. These pairs enable separate evaluation of affected-region forecast accuracy and quiet-region response error. We further propose ActionST, which forecasts the intervened future by writing an explicit response onto an intervention-independent reference forecast. Specifically, node-time addressing constructs a query for each response position, a state-conditioned response writer computes candidate responses, and a graph-aware locality gate controls their strength. Experiments on six datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of ActionST at new action targets, with the lowest mean absolute error on five datasets and the best average rank. Our source code and the PairST benchmark are available at https://github.com/yutong-xia/ActionST.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PairST 基准，在交通、输电与配水网络上构造来自同一状态的配对参考／干预未来，以分别评估受影响区域精度与静默区域误响应；并提出 ActionST，在无干预参考预测上写入显式响应，由节点-时间寻址查询、状态条件响应写入器和图感知局部性门控共同决定响应强度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其反事实配对评价与「局部性门控的残差式状态写入」可能为 LVR 提供线索：如何判断 latent 状态是否因果地使用了视觉证据，以及如何限制证据注入的强度与范围；跨领域迁移尚待核查。
